title: ITjuzi: Chinese embodied AI companies raised ~$13B across 322 deals in H1 2026, up 5x YoY, as robot makers shift focus from hardware to AI (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: ITjuzi: Chinese embodied AI companies raised ~$13B across 322 deals in H1 2026, up 5x YoY, as robot makers shift focus from hardware to AI — After years of building humanoid robots capable of running, dancing and performing backflips, Chinese companies are pouring resources into a different challenge …
